First frame: planted four-legged side view facing RIGHT, matching the end of an existing gallop; last frame: the exact front-facing seated master. Preserve identical face, ears, iris colors, fur markings, head/body proportions, soft illustrated3D fur, animal size and painted floor height throughout. Locked orthographic camera and constant canvas scale; saturated uniform #00FF00 background, no cast shadows, text, props, cuts, zoom or reframing. All body parts remain connected, no extra paws, changing coat or enlarged head. The complete action starts immediately from the side stance; NEVER insert a front-facing sitting pose before the stopping movement. A realistic athletic BRAKING STOP from a rightward gallop: immediately take one short forward running footfall, lower the shoulders, plant both front paws ahead and let the hips briefly continue forward, flex elbows and hind legs to absorb momentum, then plant the hind paws and settle on all four feet by1.2seconds. No sliding or falling for this take. Only after the brake has completed, calmly turn toward the camera and sit into the exact final reference by3.3seconds. End with a calm seated hold in the final reference for at least0.5seconds. Four seconds total. Keep the overall physical root near the original center and floor plane fixed; the app supplies horizontal world travel. Show momentum through coherent paw contact, shoulders, hips and spine, with smooth acceleration and recovery, no sudden root or pose jumps.
